title: Investigating the impact of animal-derived milk on pro- and anti-inflammatory immune responses in healthy subjects
summary:
The aim of the study is to investigate whether the consumption of cow's milk leads to an inflammatory immune response that can be detected in the blood. As a result, we hope for a better understanding of the effect of cow's milk on our body, since other research work has already shown that milk can cause inflammatory effects. This applies in particular to the milk protein beta-casein, kappa-casein and the milk fat membrane protein butyrophilin. In the context of further research approaches to the role of nutrition in the event of inflammatory diseases of the central nervous system, this could be of relevance.
Since the composition of the intestinal microbiome and the permeability of the intestinal wall can also contribute to increased immune responses, these parameters will also be measured and associated with the immune response against milk proteins.
conditions: Impact of diet on the immune system
